clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, young night elf priests answer a call from the Sisterhood of Elune. Their early journeys prepare them for deeper instruction from Priestess Alathea.

The Sisterhood of Elune guides young acolytes in the Temple of the Moon, from their first prayers toward mastery of lunar magic. Night elves place their faith in the Mother Moon, Elune, unlike humans and dwarves, whose priests follow the Holy Light. When a novice priest reaches a milestone in devotion, senior mentors take notice and mark the disciple as ready to bear greater divine power.

Priestess Alathea brings the Sisterhood's summons to the acolyte. She recognizes their dedication and welcomes them into traditions preserved across millennia. By accepting the rite, the priest seals a bond to Elune and gains access to protective wards and lunar invocations unique to the kaldorei faith.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
